messages:
Mira: opened PR #834 to tighten up tool-calling docs + structured-output patterns. Main goals: concise SDK snippets, one compact JSON schema example showing array-of-unions, migration note for function_call -> tools, and a short guardrails subsection. Can @Sam own SDK snippets, @Alex take parsing fallback text, @Priya hunt links, @Jordan add Go sample, @Eli run example smoke tests? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834

Sam: I got SDK snippets. Proposing Node streaming example + Python sync + iterator. Will replace any literal keys with env placeholders. Also suggest we add a short token-cost comment near streaming.

Alex: For parsing guidance, add an explicit tiny schema that demonstrates union arrays and a pragmatic fallback rule: if JSON parse fails, extract JSON-like substrings and coerce types (string -> {id: string}) before validating. Example schema I recommend: { type: 'object', properties: { op: {type: 'string', enum: ['get','put']}, items: { type: 'array', items: { anyOf: [{type: 'string'}, {type: 'object', properties: {id: {type: 'string'}}}] } } }, required: ['op'] }

Priya: Found two stale links in the older pages: /docs/toolcalling -> /docs/tool-calling/overview, and an image at static.redwood.ai/old/toolflow.png 404s. I'll push link fixes and remove the image.

Jordan: Adding Go snippet now. Will show context cancellation for streaming and JSON decoding from stream frames. Will keep it compact.

Eli: I can run the examples smoke tests. Plan: run ./scripts/check-examples and a quick integration against the stubbed tool harness in CI. Will report back failures.

Sam: Pushed Node + Python snippets in a small commit. Node uses `stream: true` and the new streaming helper; included env placeholder usage.

Mira: thanks. I added a short migration diff block that shows the old function_call field and the new `tools` array. Also wrote a 1-line human summary under the compact schema, and an edge-case note about nullable items in arrays.

Alex: Suggest adding a tiny guardrail: prefer compact envelopes ({action, args}) instead of verbose logs, and recommend a 1k token soft-limit for tool responses. Also link to the parse runbook for plaintext fallback.

Priya: patch pushed that fixes anchors and removes the bad image. I also normalized headings so the preview highlight looks correct.

preview-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/pr-834 (status: success) — anchors render, snippets highlighted.

Eli: Ran smoke tests: ./scripts/check-examples -> two failures: (1) python snippet missing import typing.List, (2) example harness expects `tools` schema key `name` but our sample used `id`. Filing a quick fix commit.

Sam: fixed the Python import, swapped `id` -> `name` in the sample tool config to match harness expectations. Re-ran lints, all green.

Jordan: Verified Go example compiles in the minimal playground. Left a tiny comment to show `context.WithTimeout` usage explicitly for streaming cancellation.

Mira: I addressed the comment and updated the Go snippet. Also replaced any sample keys with ENV placeholders across all snippets.

Alex: LGTM from parsing POV after small wording tweak about coercion order (prefer structural coerce then regex).

Sam: final pass from SDK side, LGTM.

Priya: +1 from docs side. Anchors and links validated.

Mira: Merging now if there are no objections. Target: merge today and follow up with an issue to snapshot examples into the eval harness.

docs-bot: PR #834 merged by Mira into main (commit: a9c4d5b). Release note: docs: refine tool-calling and structured-output examples, add migration diff and guardrails.

Mira: Thanks team! I'll file the follow-up issue to add an integration smoke check that runs the examples against the stubbed tool endpoint. If anyone sees downstream SDK breakage, please tag me.

Eli: I'll open the integration ticket and assign to `examples-infra` squad.
